articles.title: Chenab river water level rises in J&K’s Reasi as Salal Dam opens 4 gates
articles.summary: The Chenab river's water level rose in Reasi district on Tuesday. Authorities opened four gates of the Salal Dam to manage increased reservoir inflow.

articles.title: 100-year-old Hindu temple demolished in Pakistan’s Punjab
articles.summary: A historic Hindu temple in Pakistan's Punjab province was demolished on August 21. Minority groups allege religious zealots targeted the site for adjacent madrassa land.

articles.title: Hardik Pandya's comeback plans hit a fresh roadblock
articles.summary: Hardik Pandya’s return to international cricket is set to face another setback due to a leg niggle, casting doubts on his participation in the upcoming T20I series against Afghanistan. He remains under observation by the medical team at BCCI CoE..

articles.title: 'Distinct cash shortfall': Rs 7.4 crore in PNB vault swapped with fake notes in UP
articles.summary: Authorities are reeling after discovering that ₹7.4 crore in actual cash was exchanged for phony currency at a Saharanpur PNB vault. An FIR has been filed against involved bank staff and private citizens.

articles.title: Oklahoma man found at 92 pounds after addiction graduates with 4.0 GPA
Brazil’s humpback whales make stunning comeback; population surges from just 2,000 to nearly 35,000
articles.summary: Brazil’s humpback whale population has recovered from about 2,000 to nearly 35,000 after commercial whaling pushed the species close to extinction. Protection measures and a global whaling ban helped the whales return to Brazil’s waters.

articles.title: A man bought 51,000 acres of degraded land in Florida; decades later, it is the largest private restoration project east of the Mississippi
articles.summary: Advocating for biodiversity, E.O. Wilson suggests that dedicating half of Earth to nature is crucial for preventing a sixth mass extinction.

articles.title: Lindsay Clancy Trial: Matt Walsh slams jury delay; warns of ‘dire’ implications
articles.summary: Matt Walsh has strongly criticized the delay in the Lindsay Clancy trial, saying the jury should have reached a verdict much faster. Clancy is accused of killing her three children in 2023.

articles.summary: IBPS has begun registrations for Regional Rural Banks recruitment across India. Applications are open for Office Assistants and various Officer Scale positions.

articles.title: IOB SO recruitment 2026: Indian Overseas Bank invites applications for 291 posts; apply by September 15
articles.summary: Indian Overseas Bank has announced recruitment for 291 officer positions across various scales. Applications are open online from August 29 to September 15, 2026.

articles.title: CTET 2026 September registration window closes today; CBSE yet to announce exam date: Direct link to apply here
articles.summary: The CBSE CTET 2026 registration window closes today for aspiring teachers. Candidates can apply for eligibility to teach Classes 1 to 8.

articles.title: J&K MBBS, BDS interns launch indefinite strike over low stipend, seek hike to Rs 30,000
articles.summary: MBBS and BDS interns in Jammu and Kashmir have begun an indefinite strike demanding a hike in their monthly stipend from Rs 12,300 to Rs 30,000. The interns cite rising living costs, extended hospital duties and disparities with other states.

articles.title: Keerthy Suresh celebrates Onam with husband Antony Thattil; shares happy family pictures
articles.summary: Keerthy Suresh celebrated Onam with her husband Antony Thattil and close family members. She shared pictures of the festivities, including her pet dog Nyke.

articles.title: Lionel Messi RETIRES: Kareena Kapoor Khan REACTS
articles.summary: Football legend Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football. This decision has prompted emotional tributes from fans and celebrities worldwide.

articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh': Visually impaired Suneel crooned film's viral song
articles.summary: Suneel Lodhi, a visually impaired singer, has captured hearts across the nation with a viral Hanuman bhajan. His distinct and soulful voice not only garnered attention but also led him to an unexpected film role in the surprising box-office hit 'Hanuman Ansh'.

articles.title: Rob and Michele Reiner’s son Jake Reiner gets married
articles.summary: In a poignant moment amid personal turmoil, Jake Reiner recently wedded Maria Gilfillan in a heartfelt private ceremony, mere months after the heartbreaking loss of his parents. Coupled with this joyous event is the distressing news of his brother Nick Reiner's arrest on murder charges.
